meta_description:
307K likes, 816 comments - beerbiceps on August 25, 2026: "Love you, Ladakh. Kind of sad I couldn’t stay here for longer.

One of the most peaceful trips I’ve ever had, I self reflected more than I expected, learned so much about Buddhist culture, mountain life and honestly about myself too. I feel like a different person coming back from here. ❤️🏔️

Song Credits:- The Silent Echo (@sumansen )

#ladakh #travel #beerbiceps".
